reference_dax:
EVALUATE
ROW("Gross Sales", [Gross Sales],
    "Total Discounts", [Total Discounts])

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'DimStore'[City],
    "Net Sales", [Net Sales],
    "Gross Profit", [Gross Profit]
)

EVALUATE
TOPN(
    5,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'DimProduct'[Brand],
        "Net Sales", [Net Sales]
    ),
    [Net Sales], DESC,
    'DimProduct'[Brand], ASC
)
ORDER BY [Net Sales] DESC, 'DimProduct'[Brand] ASC

EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Average Net Sales per Order",
    DIVIDE(
        [Net Sales],
        DISTINCTCOUNT('FactSales'[OrderID])
    )
)

EVALUATE
FILTER(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'FactSales'[Channel],
        "Net Sales", [Net Sales]
    ),
    [Net Sales] > 100000
)
